newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IPCO requests share halt pending news.
newsitem.headline: IPCO requests share halt pending news.

text.p: Construction company IPCO International Ltd said on Friday it had requested trade in its shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore to be suspended pending an announcement.
IPCO said in a statement it requested the suspension "due to a material development in our business in Latin America which occurred over the May Day holiday".
No details of the development were disclosed, but a further statement was expected to be issued shortly, IPCO said.
